mapper.select: SELECT main_order_flow_no FROM ftp_tc_user_common_warning WHERE id_ = #{id}

SELECT w.id_, w.svc_num, w.cust_name, w.developer_name, w.developer_id, -- 前端「预警明细」表格列别名（对齐 PC 页 specialActivityWarning/deal 的 prop 命名） w.hq_svc_type AS serviceName, w.prod_name AS prodType, -- 活动ID/活动名称/活动生效时间/活动失效时间 取自 WARNING_INFO 的 || 分段 SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(w.warning_info, '||', 1), '||', -1) AS newSchemeId, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(w.warning_info, '||', 2), '||', -1) AS schemeName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(w.warning_info, '||', 3), '||', -1) AS effTime, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(w.warning_info, '||', 4), '||', -1) AS expTime, w.ep_special_scheme_name AS newSchemeName, w.ep_special_create_date AS renewalTime, w.ep_special_eff_date AS newEffTime, w.ep_special_exp_date AS newExpTime, w.user_status, w.area_name, w.county_id, w.open_date, w.warning_info, w.ep_special_scheme_name, w.ep_special_create_date, w.ep_special_eff_date, w.ep_special_exp_date, w.grp_code, w.grp_name, w.main_order_flow_no, w.county_id AS county_name, c.cycle_flag, c.warning_info AS cycle_warning_info FROM ftp_tc_user_common_warning w LEFT JOIN ftp_tc_user_cycle_warning c ON c.order_flow_no = w.order_flow_no AND c.id_ = (SELECT MAX(c2.id_) FROM ftp_tc_user_cycle_warning c2 WHERE c2.order_flow_no = w.order_flow_no) WHERE w.warning_type = '000032' AND w.main_order_flow_no = #{mainOrderFlowNo} ORDER BY w.id_
